## Description

```
Create Cinematic AI Videos 👉 https://parkerprompts.com/Higgsfield-1

In this video, I show how to connect Claude to Higgsfield and use GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and Seedance 2.5 to create four cinematic AI short films without writing the generation prompts myself. I walk through setting up the MCP connector, creating consistent character and animal reference sheets, and generating complete 30-second films in realistic fantasy, hand-drawn anime, American cartoon, and black-and-white noir styles.

Grab The FREE System 👉 https://parker-prompts.com/freesystem

I'm Parker. I started this YouTube Channel with the goal to learn more about AI myself and to then pass on the knowledge to anyone willing to listen.

let's work together: partnerships @ parker-prompts.com

This video is sponsored by Higgsfield.

Links in this description are affiliate links — if you sign up through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
```
